newsitem.title: UK: Mixed Bosnian government delegation visits Britain.
newsitem.headline: Mixed Bosnian government delegation visits Britain.

text.p: British diplomats on Wednesday welcomed a visit to London by an ethnically mixed delegation representing the government of Bosnia.

They said the group, headed by Foreign Minister Jadranko Prlic, a Croat, with Serb deputy minister for trade and the economy Gavro Bogic as his deputy, was the first of its kind to travel together since peace returned to Bosnia.
"One would like to think it will be the beginning of a normal trend," one senior diplomat said.

Prlic on Tuesday met his British opposite number Malcolm Rifkind and returned to the Foreign Office on Wednesday for talks with Sir Nicholas Bonsor, a junior minister with responsibility for Balkan affairs.
